blocks.orig: The Forest Hill Hotel in Arusha offers luxury and tranquillity, surrounded by lush grounds overlooking Mount Meru. An abundance of trees and plants sustains many species of small mammals, reptiles and birds that reside around the property. Settle in spacious ensuite rooms (from single to triple), enjoy good food and warm hospitality in the restaurant, and take a dive in the beautiful infinity pool, while listening to the birds all around you, drink in hand, and savouring the view over Arusha’s iconic mountain.
blocks.html: The Forest Hill Hotel in Arusha combines luxury with tranquillity, set in lush grounds with a view of Mount Meru. Its many trees and plants support a variety of small mammals, reptiles and birds that live around the property. Settle into a spacious ensuite room (single to triple), enjoy good food and warm hospitality in the restaurant, and take a dip in the beautiful infinity pool, drink in hand, while birds sing all around you and you take in the view of Arusha’s iconic mountain.
